messages.subject: R Markdown acting weird
parts:
Hello Magical D-RUG Community, 
My puppy (I kid you not) jumped up on my desk and ran all over the keyboard while my R Markdown file was open. Now within a chunk of code the dollar signs are pink, the commented lines are blue, when I try and use the dollar sign after a dataframe to reassign a column it can't find the column (even though I know it exists). It only executes things in the console...?! 

HELP! I have no idea what happened and my googling efforts have been fruitless.

Thank you!
Hannah

--
Hannah Waterhouse, M.S.
PhD Candidate, Soils and Biogeochemistry Graduate Group
University of California, Davis

the culprit was an extra ``` 

Thank you!
